Argh!
Guess I couldn't push past my limits this time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon

Perhaps there was something missing
in the hypotheses from our past research.

text_block_list.text:

Heheh... Ah, I truly never tire of this!

text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-kun.
Why don't we summarize what each of us has learned?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my research spirit is burning!
Follow me, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good, good, so you do understand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We must constantly pursue every possibility.
Giving up is simply not an option.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's head right back and continue our research.
All for the glorious future of Umamusume!
